title: Dunia Ka Sabse Bada Wingspan!
idea: The snowy albatross has a massive wingspan of up to 3.7 meters and can fly without flapping for hours.

lines.text: Kya aap jaante ho ki is pakshi ka wingspan 3.7 meter tak hota hai?
Ye kisi bhi zinda pakshi mein sabse bada wingspan hai!
Itna bada ki ye bina pankh hilaaye ghanto hawa mein reh sakta hai.
Flight ke dauran inki speed 135 km/h tak record ki gayi hai!
Aur ye ek saal mein 120,000 km se zyada ka safar karte hain.
Kya aap itne bade wingspan wale pakshi ko dekhna chahenge?

facts.claim: The snowy albatross has a wingspan of up to 3.7 meters.
It is capable of remaining in the air without flapping its wings for several hours at a time.
During flight, speeds of 135 km/h have been recorded.
Some individual snowy albatrosses cover more than 120,000 km in one year.
